title: Private Hold Elections and Extensions: Terms of the Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations Tiers
content:
Under every tier of **Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations**, a bed held at the resident's own expense is held on a written election, within the limits below.

### Terms by tier

| Tier | Resident may keep holding the bed privately once payer-covered days are used up | Most consecutive privately paid hold days on one reservation before the hold must be renewed in writing | Hours after the transfer notice is delivered within which a private hold must be elected for days from the departure date to be held | From when a private hold elected after that window runs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Medicaid Hospital Leave Reserved Bed | Yes | 30 | 24 | the day of election |
| Medicaid Therapeutic Leave Reserved Bed | Yes | 30 | 24 | the day of election |
| Private Pay Hospital Leave Bed Hold | No | 30 | 24 | the day of election |
| Private Pay Therapeutic Leave Bed Hold | No | 30 | 24 | the day of election |
| Medicare Skilled Stay Hospital Leave Bed Hold | No | 30 | 24 | the day of election |
| Medicare Skilled Stay Therapeutic Leave Bed Hold | No | 30 | 24 | the day of election |

### Notes on the terms

1. The extension column concerns only the days after payer-covered reserved days are used up. On the two Medical Assistance tiers the resident may elect to continue privately; on the private pay and Medicare skilled stay tiers the column reads No.
2. The 30-day figure is a run of consecutive privately paid hold days on one reservation; reaching it, the hold must be renewed in writing to continue.
3. The 24-hour window runs from the delivery of the transfer notice. An election inside it holds the bed from the departure date; an election after it holds the bed only from the day of election.

### Illustration (hypothetical)

A transfer notice is delivered at 16:00 on a hypothetical day. A written private election received at 11:00 the next day falls inside the 24 hours and holds the bed from the departure date. An election received at 17:00 the next day falls outside the window and holds the bed from that day of election only.
